title: Macro Context Composition Confounding Audit
question: Across the complete authoritative macro-map census of twelve comparable lifecycle-context contrasts, does raw pooled association differ materially and broadly from the same contrast after exact strategy-by-period composition centering?
hypothesis: Context groups often contain different strategy and period mixtures. If composition is an important causal-identification burden, subtracting each lifecycle's exact strategy-period baseline should move raw stressed-R and stop contrasts by economically nontrivial amounts across several independent units and source programs rather than in one isolated topic.
why_now: After Program 7 Unit 051, three distinct economic units closed under Programs 4, 1 and 5. A causally clean Program 2 STLFSI4 proposal was then rejected outcome-free for structural high-stress sparsity, while two independent Program 3 proposals were already rejected for sparse exact-time batches and order-type confounding. Programs 1, 4 and 5 are recent. The whole-map comparison therefore favors one finite Program 7 causal-estimator audit spanning prior Programs 1 through 4 over forcing a thin Program 2/3 question or extending recent economic work.

macro_recomparison.program_1: Unit 053 just closed on US500 range-break breadth; no adjacent market-structure, lookback, side or horizon question may open.
macro_recomparison.program_2: Official ALFRED STLFSI4 initial releases were made causally usable with a strict-before-release-date rule, but above-normal stress covered only 7 of 197 releases and 68 births, with zero P2 and P4 births. Rejected before allocation with no threshold, percentile, lag or external-series substitution.
macro_recomparison.program_3: Oldest durable allocation, but exact-time multi-signal batches were only 29 of 2,400 times and the native order funnel confounded post-order nonfill with Passive identity. Neither proposal is widened or rescued.
macro_recomparison.program_4: Unit 052 is recent and closed without a peer-exit management successor.
macro_recomparison.program_5: Unit 054 just closed without a loss-day, allocation, lot, slot or risk-governor successor.
macro_recomparison.program_7: Selected after three intervening economic units for a distinct composition-confounding question, not another acquisition-yield, attrition, scheduler or default-lane audit.
macro_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7. Do not continue automatically into another estimator, alternative centering, weighting, matching, regression or meta census.

rejected_preselection_proposal.official_series: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index, STLFSI4
rejected_preselection_proposal.causal_availability_rule: Use only the latest ALFRED initial-release value whose realtime_start_date is strictly before the birth server date; same-date values are never used.
rejected_preselection_proposal.rejection_reason: The natural above-zero state is structurally absent in two periods and concentrated in seven release weeks, so it cannot support a broad portfolio context unit.

distinction_from_closed_meta_work.frontier_evidence_path_yield_043: Unit 043 compared tracked versus fresh evidence-authority yield. Unit 055 uses only authoritative tracked results and asks how estimator composition changes the same contrasts.
distinction_from_closed_meta_work.macro_frontier_attrition_051: Unit 051 counted authority, materiality and candidate-translation attrition. Unit 055 neither counts funnel stages nor classifies prior passes; all included contrasts enter regardless of sign, size or verdict.
distinction_from_closed_meta_work.underlying_economic_units: Unit 055 does not repair, reinterpret or reopen any source unit. Its centered effects and original verdicts remain immutable; raw contrasts are a finite causal-diagnostic counterview only.

fixed_contrast_reconstruction.raw_r: Raw pooled mean stressed R of the named variant minus raw pooled mean stressed R of its exact named comparator. Cell-based comparators are n-weighted over all available strategy-period cells.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.raw_stop: Raw pooled stop rate of the named variant minus raw pooled stop rate of its exact named comparator. Cell-based comparators are n-weighted over all available strategy-period cells.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.centered_r: Read the frozen source result's exact strategy-period-centered stressed-R contrast using the census field mapping.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.centered_stop: Read the frozen source result's exact strategy-period-centered stop contrast using the census field mapping.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.signed_adjustment: centered minus raw in the same channel.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.sign: -1 below zero, 0 exactly zero, +1 above zero; no epsilon or rounding is used for classification.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.direction_reversal: Raw and centered signs are both nonzero and opposite.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.full_material_threshold_status_change: Exactly one of raw and centered absolute effects reaches the source-epoch full material threshold, 0.10R or 0.05 stop.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.r_composition_sensitive: Absolute stressed-R adjustment is at least 0.05R, exactly half the source-epoch full 0.10R material threshold.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.stop_composition_sensitive: Absolute stop-rate adjustment is at least 0.025, exactly half the source-epoch full 0.05 material threshold.
fixed_contrast_reconstruction.median: Sort all twelve finite absolute adjustments; for the even population, average positions six and seven.

fixed_metrics.contrast_rows: For all twelve contrasts report unit, source program, raw and centered R/stop effects, signed/absolute adjustments, signs, direction reversals, full-threshold status changes and channel sensitivity flags.
fixed_metrics.channel_summary: For R and stop separately report sensitive count/share, represented units/programs, median and maximum absolute adjustment, direction reversals, full-threshold status changes, and sensitive-case unit/program concentration.
fixed_metrics.joint_context: Report contrasts sensitive in both channels, in R only, in stop only and in neither. Joint counts do not replace either channel gate.

R_COMPOSITION_CONFOUNDING: At least 4 of 12 contrasts are R composition-sensitive.
Sensitive R contrasts span at least 3 of 6 units and at least 3 of 4 source programs.
Median absolute R adjustment across all 12 contrasts is at least 0.025R.
No one unit contributes more than 50% and no one source program more than 60% of sensitive R contrasts.
STOP_COMPOSITION_CONFOUNDING: At least 4 of 12 contrasts are stop composition-sensitive.
Sensitive stop contrasts span at least 3 of 6 units and at least 3 of 4 source programs.
Median absolute stop adjustment across all 12 contrasts is at least 0.0125.
No one unit contributes more than 50% and no one source program more than 60% of sensitive stop contrasts.
fixed_channel_gates.zero_sensitive_rule: If a channel has no sensitive contrast, its concentration shares are null and every breadth/concentration requirement fails rather than dividing by zero.
fixed_channel_gates.pass_rule: A channel passes only if every count, breadth, median and concentration requirement passes. Direction reversal and full-threshold status change are reported but are not substitute gates.

fixed_bundle_gate.authority_limit: Finite consumed-evidence causal diagnosis only. It cannot revise source verdicts, select an estimator, suppress a macro program, create a default lane, choose a trading behavior or authorize Live.

Do not repair or reinterpret any underlying unit, use its verdict as a feature, modify MQL, compile, run MetaTrader, inspect Program 6, retain a CLI, query broker/account state or touch Live.
